Zeta23.WeilEF.vertical_line_shift.statement: theorem Zeta23.WeilEF.vertical_line_shift : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ}, a ≤ b → (∀ (s : ℂ), a ≤ s.re → s.re ≤ b → DifferentiableAt ℂ f s) → ∀ {φ : ℝ → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Integrable φ MeasureTheory.volume → (∀ (σ t : ℝ), a ≤ σ → σ ≤ b → ‖f (↑σ + ↑t * Complex.I)‖ ≤ φ t) → Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atBot (nhds 0) → ∫ (t : ℝ), f (↑b + ↑t * Complex.I) = ∫ (t : ℝ), f (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)
Zeta23.WeilEF.vertical_line_shift.source_header: {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ∀ s : ℂ, a ≤ s.re → s.re ≤ b → DifferentiableAt ℂ f s) {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : Integrable φ) (hbound : ∀ (σ t : ℝ), a ≤ σ → σ ≤ b → ‖f (σ + t * I)‖ ≤ φ t) (hφtop : Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (hφbot : Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atBot (nhds 0)) : ∫ t : ℝ, f (b + t * I) = ∫ t : ℝ, f (a + t * I)
Zeta23.WeilEF.vertical_line_shift.premises: hφ : Integrable φ, hφtop : Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atTop (nhds 0), hφbot : Filter.Tendsto φ Filter.atBot (nhds 0)
